questions.upgradePremium: How do I upgrade to Premium?
questions.upgradePremiumAnswer: Go to Profile → Unlock Premium, choose a plan that suits you. Monthly, yearly, and lifetime options are available.
questions.restorePurchase: How do I restore my purchase?
questions.restorePurchaseAnswer: Go to the Unlock Premium page and tap "Restore Purchase" at the bottom. Your purchase history will sync automatically.
questions.editProfile: How do I edit my profile?
questions.editProfileAnswer: Tap the avatar area at the top of your profile to enter the edit page, where you can update your avatar, name, and more.
questions.switchLanguageTheme: How do I switch language or theme?
questions.switchLanguageThemeAnswer: Go to Profile → Preferences to switch language and theme. Supports English, Chinese, Japanese, and light, dark, or system theme modes.
questions.contactSupportAnswer: If you encounter any issues, please email {{email}} and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
